info.title: rag-jev
info.description: Select useful context from existing retrieval results. No ingestion required.

cost_basis.title: Cost Basis
cost_basis.default: Estimate from configured per-million rates; excludes retrieval and caching discounts

timing_basis.title: Timing Basis
timing_basis.default: Generation measured now; selected stage adds original scoring time. Retrieval excluded.

citation_check.title: Citation Check
citation_check.default: Citation IDs checked; factual support and answer correctness are not graded

quality_basis.title: Quality Basis
quality_basis.default: Binary relevance labels supplied by the caller; candidate evidence recall and nDCG at the shared top-N cutoff (short outputs padded with zero gain). Answer correctness and factual support require review.

cost_basis.title: Cost Basis
cost_basis.default: Configured API rates: Jev plus generation per deployed arm. Unknown rates/usage stay null. Retrieval, local compute, cache discounts excluded. Shared Jev scoring paid once in this comparison, not once per arm.

timing_basis.title: Timing Basis
timing_basis.default: Recorded Jev time plus measured policy and generation time; retrieval excluded. This replay is not a fresh latency benchmark. Identical contexts reuse one answer.

selection_basis.title: Selection Basis
selection_basis.default: Original input order versus Jev ordering versus equal-weight RRF (k=60), same candidate set and top-N/token limits. Pins/groups preserved in all arms. Recorded baseline_ids are not used; original means input-order selection here.

token_estimator.title: Token Estimator
token_estimator.default: cl100k_base estimate; actual prompt usage appears after generation

token_estimator.title: Token Estimator
token_estimator.default: cl100k_base passage-text estimate; excludes prompts, separators and output
